name: asked-before
description: Records the how-to questions you ask Claude Code onto your Asked Before library cards, and runs cold reps on them in the chat. Needs Node.js 20 or later.

server_url.title: Asked Before server
server_url.description: Your Asked Before server's address, such as https://asked-before.example

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A key from your Asked Before Settings page, ab_<id>_<secret>

shelf.title: Default shelf
shelf.description: Optional: the shelf, by name or id, that questions go to when the agent names none
